## Эксперименты

- cera-moa-routing-contract-20261108: SYNTHETIC / PASS. 10,000 deterministic training-like/inference-like scenarios. Independent oracle reproduced the case digest; 10,000/10,000 routing-contract checks passed. Arithmetic recomputation of author table values: Qwen OOD mean 72.7833, heterogeneous OOD mean 71.8333, Top-2 token reduction 44.8099%. Synthetic routing-rule contract and author-table arithmetic only. No hidden states, model weights, LoRA adapters, RL training, benchmark tasks, target project, or production service. Author results remain AUTHOR_REPORTED / NOT_REPRODUCED.
